The '''father''' of [[Sleta Suke]] served as the ambassador from [[Orto/Legends|Orto]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sleta Suke's father was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. The guide states that a gang known as [[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones|The Lost Ones]] would attempt to kidnap Sleta Suke. If successful, the ambassador will hire the player characters to find her and bring her home.<ref name="CatCW" />
